notes.title: 🔄 Update 1.2
notes.content: [p]Thank you for your feedback on [url="http://discord.echoes-of-the-architects.com/"]discord[/url] and the forums![/p][p]Here's the new update addressing some of them:[/p][list][*][p]All modules, classes and tactics are now unlocked (no more unlock points).[/p][/*][*][p]Competitive mode is unlocked at level 3.[/p][/*][*][p]When time runs out and both bases took the same amount of damage, the game switches to Sudden Death mode: the first player to damage the enemy base wins and the unit budget maluses are removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Your opponent AIs are visible in training and campaign modes.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: All modules, classes and tactics are now unlocked (no more unlock points).
Competitive mode is unlocked at level 3.
When time runs out and both bases took the same amount of damage, the game switches to Sudden Death mode: the first player to damage the enemy base wins and the unit budget maluses are removed.
Your opponent AIs are visible in training and campaign modes.

notes.title: Echoes of the Architects Demo is Live!
notes.content:
Hello Architects,

The wait is over! The [b]demo for Echoes of the Architects[/b] is available on Steam.

Echoes of the Architects is a fast-paced real-time strategy game that allows you to design your own modular and programmable units.
Use strategic thinking and adaptability as you deploy your army and tactics to outsmart your opponents in dynamic skirmishes.

The demo includes all core features of the game, offering [b]30 to 60 minutes of gameplay[/b], where you can:
[list]
[*] [b]Customize Modular Units[/b]: Design your army by choosing from a variety of modules to suit your strategy.
[*] [b]Program Unit Behaviors[/b]: Set up advanced strategies with behavior scripting to outwit your opponents.
[*] [b]Test Your Tactics[/b]: Engage in challenging skirmishes that require strategic planning and adaptability.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3136490/Echoes_of_the_Architects/

And if you like the demo, don't forget to [b]add the game to your wishlist[/b] to stay updated on the full release!

Thanks for your continued support, and I can't wait to see the strategies you come up with!

Stay tactical!
GFX47
